candidates.change_summary: Change return value from true to false.
Replace return true with return !true (i.e., false) via expression change.
Replace require(_s) with require(!_s), making success revert and failure continue, which changes return value when all calls are successful.
Change require(_tos.length > 0) to require(_tos.length == 0), which inverts the condition and allows the function to return true for empty arrays, changing behavior.
Delete the require(_tos.length > 0) statement, allowing empty arrays and changing return value to true for calls that previously reverted.

Replace caddress.call with a call to address(0), causing all calls to fail and revert, but if checks are removed it may change return value; here we replace the selector id with a non-existent function so all calls succeed returning false but require(_s) reverts — instead we change require(_s) to require(true) to always succeed and alter return to false.
